title: Travel occupies the calendar
hook: The meeting fits. Does the journey fit too?

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Reserve travel as a separate time block.

objective: Reserve travel as a separate time block.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: The meeting fits. Does the journey fit too? Which layout includes the journey? Correct option: Travel before meeting. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred.

claims.text: Travel time occupies a block just as the meeting does. In this fixture, an overlap means the same person is booked twice.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred.

claims.text: Every displayed result is computed from the visible exercise state: schedule. Exercise only; no measured productivity gain. The reveal reports this same state and never translates its score into a personal productivity or memory benefit.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/studyModels.ts and src/components/lifehacks/StudyLesson.tsx, calendar-needs-travel fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts. Stage rules: finish=start+duration; overlap is pairwise intersection length; last finish=max finish; deadline spill=max(0,last finish-deadline).

claims.text: For a 14:30 meeting and a fixed 20-minute trip with no delay, latest departure is 14:10.
claims.source: Arithmetic:14:30−00:20=14:10. A stipulated duration and no-delay assumption, not a real travel-time recommendation.

recall.question: A meeting starts at 14:30. The trip takes 20 minutes with no delay. What is the latest departure?
recall.why: Reserve the trip before arrival: 14:30 minus 20 minutes is 14:10. Real journey uncertainty is outside this fixed-duration exercise.
